Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: Incorrect Comparison in Conclusion. The Planner correctly identified the birth dates (Reginald Le Borg: 1902, Hervé Bromberger: 1918) but erroneously concluded that the director of the 1902-born individual (Le Borg) was younger. The logic was reversed: a person born in 1902 is older than a person born in 1918. The Planner failed to apply the correct chronological logic to determine who is "younger" (later birth date).
